description: Great hunts (realm raids): the muster, the march, the boss fight, victory or failure, and answering the Horn of Rallying.

lines.text: The muster for {raid} is gathering. Bring potions and patience.
On my way. Saving my best gear for this one.
The column is moving toward {raid}. Stay together and keep to the road.
{boss} is in sight! Healers, keep your distance. Everyone else, hold the line!
Spread out and stay off its front!
We did it! {raid} will be talked about for weeks.
Well fought, everyone. My hands are still shaking.
Not our day at {raid}. We regroup and try again another time.
The horn! {player} has called the realm to {raid}. I am on my way.
Heard the horn from here. Count me in for {raid}.
Gathering for {raid}. Check your repairs before we set out.
Anyone have spare power potions? I only brought a handful.
Topping off my healing potions before {raid}. Never enough of them.
Big turnout for {raid} tonight. Good to see so many familiar faces.
Is this the muster point? Feels like half the realm is standing here.
Bandages, potions, spare weapon. I think I am ready.
First great hunt for me. Any advice for a nervous {class}?
Nerves are kicking in already and we have not even left town.
Guild, who is coming to {raid}? Let us stand together in the line.
Evening all, heading to the muster for {raid} shortly.
Remember to bind somewhere close before we march.
Groups are forming up for {raid}. Find a party with a healer if you can.
Need one more healer in our group for {raid}.
My armour is freshly repaired and my courage is mostly intact.
Somebody tell me this hunt has a plan beyond charge and pray.
Last great hunt I went on, I spent half of it face down in the grass.
Half the realm turning out for {raid}. That is a sight.
Stocking up on arrows for {raid}. A full quiver feels like armour.
Keeping my pet close tonight. It hates crowds almost as much as I do.
Buffers, please do the rounds before we go. Long fight ahead.
I will keep the buffs rolling once we set out. Stay near me at the start.
Healers, let us sort out who covers which group before we leave.
Tanks to the front when we form up. Casters stay behind us.
Is anyone keeping count of how many we have? Looks like a good crowd.
Waiting on a few more before we set out for {raid}.
Brought my lucky shield. It has never been lucky, but I keep hoping.
Biggest muster I have seen in {zone} for a long while.
Sharpened every blade I own for {raid}.
lfg for {raid}, {class} with a full pack of potions.
Do we know who is leading this hunt?
Make sure your groups are full. Nobody walks to {raid} alone.
Who has resurrection spells? We will need more than one for this.
My stomach is in knots. Probably the bread from the tavern.
A great hunt, at last. I have been waiting weeks for this.
Quiet down and listen for the call. We move soon.
Pack light, fight heavy. That is what my old trainer always said.
Word is {raid} has sent stronger hunters than us home in pieces.
Count me in for {raid}, though I may hide behind the tanks.
Anyone want to swap spare potions for a few bandages?
Guild, gather on me at the muster. We go to {raid} together.
Checking my spells one last time. Do not want to fumble the big moment.
Stealthers should scout ahead. I will go quiet once we are near.
Somebody keep an eye on the flanks once we set out.
Realm, the muster for {raid} needs more healers!
All hands to the muster! {raid} will not hunt itself.
Hope the old timers are coming. They know these fights.
My first great hunt was a disaster. This one will be better.
If your gear is thin, stay at the back and heal or buff.
Younger ones, watch, learn and stay out of the fire.
Brought enough potions to float a ship.
We need someone to keep track of the groups. Volunteers?
Everyone set? Long walk ahead and no time to run back for potions.
The camp feels alive tonight. Everyone wants a piece of {raid}.
Camelot is buzzing. Even the guards are talking about the hunt.
Jordheim smells of oil and steel. The whole city is getting ready.
Tir na Nog is full of hunters tonight. It warms the heart.
Golestandt again? Then bring every fire resist you own.
Gjalpinulva will not wait for stragglers. Gear up.
Cuuldurach has been quiet too long. Time to wake him.
Dartmoor is a long walk. Better leave soon.
Malmohus is cold enough without a dragon breathing on us.
Sheeroe Hills again. I still remember that breath from last time.
Promised myself I would not die in the first minute this time.
Does anyone know what we are hunting? I just followed the crowd.
Bring a friend, bring a healer, bring a spare weapon.
Ready when the leaders are.
Same here. Just finishing my repairs.
Count me in, wherever we are headed.
Grouped and ready.
Nervous too. That is how you know it matters.
Just arrived at the muster. What did I miss?
Stay behind the tanks and you will be fine.
Heading over now. Save me a spot.
Bound nearby, potions full. Good to go.
Agreed. Better to wait for a full force than rush in.
My group still needs a healer too.
Healer here, looking for a group.
I will stay at the back and keep everyone standing.
I can tank if the front line looks thin.
Keep the chatter down so we hear the call.
Heard the same. Should be a good one.
Bring it on. I have been itching for a real fight.
Buffs coming, line up nice and close.
Good luck to us all.
Fine by me, as long as somebody else carries the bandages.
Do not let them leave without me!
Ha, that was me last time. Learned my lesson.
My knees are shaking, but my sword arm is fine.
Better to over-prepare. These hunts go long.
The more the merrier, I say.
Stay on the road and keep up with the column.
Moving out! Follow the leaders and do not wander off.
Stragglers, catch up. We are not stopping for anyone.
Watch for wandering monsters along the way. No need to pull extras.
Nobody aggro anything on the way to {raid}, please.
Marching to {raid}. My feet are complaining already.
Long walk to {raid}. Good time to sort out your spells.
Anyone with a speed song, keep it running.
What a sight, the whole column stretched across {zone}.
Healers in the middle of the column, tanks at the front.
Quiet as we pass the camps. No need to wake everything.
If you fall behind, shout and someone will wait.
Halfway there. Stay sharp.
Lost the column for a moment. Back with you now.
Guild, stay grouped on the march.
From the hill the column looks like an army.
Do not stop to loot anything on the way. We can come back later.
Scouting ahead. Looks clear so far.
Archers on the flanks, eyes open.
Something is following us. Probably just a wolf.
Hold up, the back of the column is lagging.
Close the gap at the back!
Steady pace, everyone. Long way to go.
Nearly at {raid}. Last chance to drink a potion and fix your nerves.
Through {zone} we go, on toward {raid}.
Marching with the whole realm feels good. Nothing can stop us.
Every step closer to {raid} my heart beats faster.
Mind the river crossing. Swimmers make easy targets.
Realm, the column for {raid} is on the move. Join it on the road.
Dartmoor at last. Stay close and keep quiet.
Into Malmohus. Watch your footing on the ice.
Onward through Sheeroe. Not far now.
Bit of a crowd at the bridge. Patience, everyone.
Tight line, people. Gaps get folk killed.
Eyes forward and weapons sheathed until we arrive.
Right behind you, keeping pace.
Keeping up, keeping up.
Watching the rear.
On the road and moving.
Caught up. Sorry about that.
My feet hate this hunt already.
Clear on my side.
Slow down a little, the healers are falling behind.
Still with the column.
Saw that too. Keep moving.
No pulling, got it.
Almost there, I can feel it.
Holding my spot near the healers.
Long road, good company.
Following the banners.
{boss} is up! Tanks, pick it up and turn it away from the group.
Spread out! Do not let {boss} hit us all at once.
Healers, stay back and stay alive. We need you more than anyone.
Adds incoming! Pick them off before they reach the healers.
Watch out for the breath! Stay off the front of {boss}.
Everyone on {boss}! Hit it with everything you have.
Keep the healers safe. Anything that touches them dies first.
{boss} is turning! Watch your positions.
Main tank is down! Someone grab {boss}!
Rez the healers first, then the tanks.
Focus {boss}, ignore the small ones unless they go for the healers.
{boss} is hitting harder now. Hold the line!
Nearly there! {boss} is bleeding badly.
{boss} is at half strength. Do not slow down now.
Pull back! Let the tanks reset.
Somebody mezz those adds!
Out of power. Drinking a potion now.
Healing as fast as I can. Somebody help the tanks!
Keep the debuffs on {boss}.
Arrows flying at {boss}. Keep it turned away from us.
Get behind it! Hit it from behind!
Taunting {boss}. Stay behind me!
Shield up, I have its attention.
My whole group is low. Heals please!
Watch for the knockback near the edge.
Do not chase the adds too far. Stay near the group.
Here it comes again. Brace yourselves.
Look at the size of {boss}. Oh my.
{boss} does not look happy to see us.
Steady now. Wait for the tanks to get hold of {boss}.
Do not pull {boss} yet! Wait for the call!
Stay in range of your healers.
Casters, nuke {boss} the moment the tanks have it.
Anyone with a resurrection, keep it ready.
Died. Somebody rez me when it is safe.
{boss} is going for the casters! Tanks, pull it back!
{boss} just flattened half a group. Spread out!
Keep your heads, everyone. We have done harder.
Hold your nerve, {boss} is almost down.
Stun the adds, slow the adds, anything!
This is what we came for. Make it count!
Every hit counts. Keep swinging!
My shield arm is going numb. Healer!
Guild, stay together on {boss}.
Pets off the adds and onto {boss}!
Second wave of adds coming from the back!
Watch your power. This will be a long fight.
Golestandt is breathing fire. Spread out before he does it again!
Gjalpinulva is awake! Nobody stand in front of her!
Cuuldurach is up! Keep away from the jaws!
Fire on the left flank! Get clear!
If you die, stay down until it is safe to rez.
Bodies everywhere. Keep fighting!
We are winning. Do not let up!
Can barely see for all the spell effects. Keep it up!
Mind the patrol, it is joining the fight!
Do not panic. Panic gets us all killed.
{boss} is getting angry. Healers, be ready.
Bring {boss} down and the realm will sing about us.
Damage dealers, do not pull it off the tanks!
Careful with the area spells near the healers!
Watch the healers' backs. Adds love to sneak in there.
On it, moving now!
Got it, moving out of the way.
Heals going out, hang on!
Adds handled, back on the boss.
Holding the line.
Low here, need a heal!
Keeping my distance.
Watch your back!
Spreading out.
Covering the healers.
Out of power too, drinking.
Still standing, barely.
Pulling the add off you.
Keep going, it is almost dead!
Ouch. That one hurt.
Rezzing who I can.
Right behind it.
Keep it turned!
Moving, moving!
That was close!
Agreed, focus fire!
Got the adds on this side.
Do not stop now!
Buffs back up.
Down but not out. Hit it for me.
Steady, we have this.
{raid} is ours! Well done, everyone!
It is down! I cannot believe we actually did it.
Victory! Somebody start a song, I am too tired.
Gratz all! What a fight.
That will go down in the realm's songs.
Loot time. Please let there be something for a {class}.
Whoever wins the loot, wear it with pride.
We beat {raid}! I need to sit down for a while.
Honour to the fallen, and to the healers who kept the rest of us standing.
Best great hunt I have ever been on.
Thank the healers. Without them we would all still be lying in the dirt.
Tanks, you were magnificent.
Guild, proud of every one of you tonight.
Realm, {raid} has fallen! Raise a cheer!
Died twice and still feel like a hero.
My armour is wrecked, but it was worth every dent.
Hope the loot is kind to us. I need new gloves badly.
Fair rolls for the loot, everyone.
Seeing that thing fall was worth the long walk.
Our realm will remember tonight.
Let us do this again soon. Same crowd.
So much experience from that fight. I can feel it.
Did not die once! First time ever.
Golestandt falls! Albion stands tall tonight.
Gjalpinulva is slain! Midgard roars!
Cuuldurach is beaten! Hibernia will sing of this.
Gather for the loot and be patient. Everyone gets a look.
My first great hunt and we won. Never forgetting this.
Never doubted us for a moment. Well, maybe once.
Somebody remind me why I was nervous.
Healers, take a bow. That was incredible.
All that preparation paid off. Well done.
Back to town to repair and brag.
{enemyrealm} will hear about this and turn green with envy.
Victory tastes even better after a long march.
Glad I came. Thank you for leading, whoever you were.
Earned that one, every last one of us.
Tired, sore and happy. A good night.
Honour to all who stood at {raid} tonight.
They will be telling stories about {raid} in every tavern.
Who got the drop? Let us see it!
Gratz everyone!
Well done, all of you. Truly.
Great fight, great company.
Best hunt in ages.
Agreed. The healers were heroes.
Thank you all. That was something special.
Count me in for the next one.
What a night!
Still can not believe it fell.
Gratz on the loot, whoever got it!
Proud to stand with you all.
Worth every potion.
Need a long rest after that.
Ha! We did it!
Hear, hear!
My first win too. What a feeling.
Honour to the realm.
We could not bring it down. Regroup in town and rest.
Called off. Too many dead, not enough healers.
Ran out of time at {raid}. Next time we start earlier.
Well, that went badly. Back to the bindstone.
Lost too many in the first push. Lesson learned.
Not every hunt ends in glory. We tried.
{raid} beat us today. It will not beat us forever.
Too few of us turned out. We need more for {raid}.
Back to town, repair, and we try again another day.
My armour is in pieces and we have nothing to show for it.
Hunt called off. Thank you all for coming anyway.
We nearly had it. So close.
The healers were spread too thin. Next time we bring more.
Guild, regroup at the usual spot. We will talk about what went wrong.
Realm, {raid} is called off. Rest up and be ready for the next horn.
Dreaming about that boss tonight, and not in a good way.
That was a long walk for a short fight.
No shame in it. Some fights need more than one try.
Next time, more tanks and fewer heroes.
Sitting at the bind point feeling sorry for myself.
Someone had to learn the pattern. Now we have.
Dusting myself off. We will be back.
Lost my nerve, lost my life, lost my potions. A fine night.
We scattered when we should have stood together.
Rest, mend gear, and keep an eye out for the next call.
Golestandt laughs at us tonight. Not for long.
Gjalpinulva wins this round. Midgard will return.
Agreed. We regroup and try again.
Next time, then.
It happens. Good effort anyway.
Heading back to town too.
We will get it next time.
My pride hurts more than my armour.
Thanks for leading. It was not your fault.
Count me in for the next attempt.
So close. So very close.
At least we learned something.
Off to repair. See you all at the next muster.
Chin up, everyone.
{player} sounded the horn! Heading for {raid} now.
That is the Horn of Rallying! Drop everything and go.
The horn calls! {raid} it is.
Heard the horn from {player}. On my way to the muster.
{player} needs us at {raid}. Who is with me?
Horn of Rallying! Realm, to arms!
Did everyone hear that? {player} is calling for {raid}.
Finishing this fight, then I am coming to {raid}.
Leaving my camp right now. The realm needs bodies at {raid}.
Guild, the horn has sounded. Let us answer it together.
A horn! Have not heard one of those in a while.
On my way, {player}. Hold the muster for me.
That horn means business. Coming.
Running to {raid}. Save some of the fun for me.
Thank you for the call, {player}. I am coming.
Too green for {raid}, but I will come and watch the big ones work.
{player} blew the horn for {raid}. Grab your potions!
Already heading to {raid}. Heard the horn from {zone}.
The horn rings across {zone}. Time to go.
Answering the horn. Healer on the way.
Tank coming for {raid}. Hold tight.
Another horn! This realm never sleeps.
Horn heard loud and clear. Gathering my gear.
Long run from here, but I will make it to {raid}.
Abandoning my hunt for this. If {player} calls, I come.
Everyone near {zone}, the horn is calling. Move!
Was just about to rest, but {player} needs us at {raid}.
{player}, I hear you. Count on one more {class}.
Who sounded the horn? Ah, {player}. Good call.
That horn means the realm needs us. No excuses.
Setting down my tools. The horn calls.
Quick, someone tell me where the muster is!
Heard the horn from the far side of {zone}. Running now.
A great hunt called for {raid}! Bring friends.
Horn sounded for {raid}. The realm rises again.
To {raid}! For {realm}!
Albion answers the horn! To the muster at once.
Midgard, the horn! Shields up and march.
Hibernia hears the horn. Gather, friends.
Camelot can wait. The horn calls me.
Leaving Jordheim now. The horn will not be ignored.
Out of Tir na Nog at a run. The horn has sounded.
My heart jumped when I heard that horn.
{player} has rallied the realm. Let us not disappoint.
A horn at this hour? Must be something big.
Bags packed, potions in hand. Heading to the horn.
Horn is blowing for {raid}! Last one there carries the bandages.
Coming from {zone}. Might be a while, start without me if you must.
Right behind you all!
On my way too.
Coming, keep the muster warm!
Heard it. Heading there now.
Me too, running now.
Wait for me!
Count me in, {player}.
Good call, {player}.
Already on the road.
Bringing my whole group.
Answering the horn as well.
Just finishing up here, then I am coming.
Grabbing potions first, then I am there.
Long run for me, but I will be there.
See you at {raid}.
Thanks, {player}. On the way.
Healer coming, hold on!
Far away, but running.
For the realm!
Same. Never ignore the horn.
